basics.name: Guillermo Castro
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer | Back-end Development, Cloud Solutions
basics.summary: Senior back-end engineer with nearly 30 years building and scaling Java and Python systems for retail, e-commerce, and finance; from microservices and cloud-native platforms to integration and messaging infrastructure. Recognized by teams as a Java subject-matter expert and mentor, with recent focus on AI-assisted development workflows (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate delivery and modernize legacy codebases.

work.name: Fusivo LLC
highlights: Founded Fusivo LLC as a corp-to-corp consulting vehicle to contract with Savoir Technologies on back-end development engagements.
Delivered high-quality code solutions that improved client systems and processes, enhancing overall efficiency.
Currently maintained in a part-time capacity for billing administration and internal projects while employed full-time elsewhere.

work.name: Zillow
highlights: Worked with the communications platform team to coordinate, develop, and maintain services for sending all communication from Zillow to the clients using remote collaboration tools (Gitlab, Slack, JIRA, Confluence, Zoom).
Developed new system for sending push notifications to mobile devices (iOS, Android) using third party services (Urban Airship).
Migrated multiple services from legacy platforms and legacy code (Spring Boot upgrades, Kubernetes, Terraform).

Leveraged multiple AI resources (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Glean) daily to increase performance, including creating multiple skills and plugins for daily project tracking, and a knowledge base with Obsidian.
Maintained multiple services using observability and monitoring tools (CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, Databricks).

work.name: Zeitview
highlights: Developed back-end software using Spring Boot for Asset Intelligence & Visualization, significantly improving operational efficiency for critical infrastructure.
Designed and implemented an asset condition scoring system using Spring technologies, enhancing cloud-native deployment strategies.
Collaborated with remote teams through code reviews and pull requests, ensuring compliance with industry standards, using modern remote collaboration tools (Github, Slack, Google Meet, JIRA).
Leveraged AI coding tools like GitHub Copilot to streamline development processes and increase productivity.

work.name: Savoir Technologies, Inc
work.summary: Consulting and staffing partner through which client engagements at Cengage Group, Office Depot, Ferguson, Manheim, and Zappos (each detailed separately below) were contracted.

work.name: Cengage Group
highlights: Developed and implemented an API integration for intra-corporate use using Spring Boot.
Designed and maintained a gateway system connecting multiple Learning Management Systems with Cengage Content Systems.
Utilized various APIs, including LTI Advantage, to enhance tool interoperability across platforms.

work.name: Office Depot, LLC
highlights: Designed and implemented microservices using Camel and Spring Boot for seamless enterprise integration.
Deployed applications on AWS and on-premises using Kubernetes, Jenkins, and Rancher.
Utilized Splunk, Dynatrace, and ELK for troubleshooting, enhancing system reliability and performance.

work.name: Ferguson
highlights: Designed and implemented a microservices-oriented REST backend platform for e-commerce applications.
Utilized Docker and OpenShift for continuous development and integration, enhancing deployment efficiency.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of new features and technologies.
Contributed to Ferguson Enterprises' growth by improving system scalability and performance.

work.name: Ella Paradis
highlights: Engaged directly, independent of the Savoir Technologies consulting relationship, between client placements.
Directed an external development team to enhance technology solutions and provide comprehensive IT support.
Designed a REST API microservices application, streamlining fulfillment, order management, and inventory tracking.
Improved system efficiency, contributing to a more agile operational framework at Ella Paradis.

work.name: Manheim
work.summary: Development and support of multiple backend systems using Open-Source frameworks Apache Camel, Karaf, ActiveMQ, PostgreSQL.

work.name: Zappos.com
highlights: Implemented robust backend systems for Zappos using modern frameworks like Spring.
Established API connections to external systems including Stripe and AWS, enhancing operational efficiency.
Streamlined internal systems for product categorization and warehouse management, improving inventory accuracy.

work.name: LeapFrog Enterprises
highlights: Developed SOA-based services for the Leapfrog Connect application Leaning Path, enhancing user engagement and functionality.
Utilized Open Source frameworks such as Spring, Apache CXF, and Mule to streamline service integration.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to optimize Oracle PL/SQL queries, improving data retrieval efficiency by 30%.

work.name: Earlier Experience
work.summary: Designed and developed enterprise Java, .NET, and Oracle/PL-SQL systems across six roles at Dextra Technologies, eMonterrey, FEMSA Comercio, IIDEA Solutions, Softtek, and H-E-B, spanning e-commerce platforms, ERP applications, and SOA integration for clients including Inktomi, Apple, Portal Software, GE Wind, and Citigroup.
